evidence_span.text: The results of our study provide unequivocal evidence for a role of HSD17B7 in cholesterol biosynthesis.

reviews.rationale: The abstract shows HSD17B7's zymosterone-to-zymosterol conversion in postsqualene cholesterol biosynthesis proven in vitro, directly supporting the enzymatic function. The unspecified in vitro/promoter system is indirect to mouse hepatocyte aging/MASLD, so the declared partial context is overclaimed.

evidence_span.text: Moreover, we found that ERG28 KO cells showed impaired SREBP-2 processing, resulting in a downregulation of many cholesterol synthesis genes.

reviews.rationale: ERG28 KO in Huh7 liver cells is an SREBP-2 target whose loss impairs SREBP-2 processing, directly supporting the mechanism-2 claim. NSDHL/MSMO1 appear only as ERG28 binding partners and HSD17B7 only as a homolog/inhibitor tool, so only Erg28 is substantively investigated; the human liver-derived cell line matches the declared partial context.

evidence_span.text: mice fed a western diet (high fat, high cholesterol; WD) exhibited a significant reduction in hepatic Rdh11 mRNA expression compared to mice fed a chow diet for 16 weeks

reviews.rationale: Hepatic Rdh11 is reduced by a high-fat/high-cholesterol diet, induced by statins, and co-regulated like LDLR/HMGCR, directly matching the SREBP2-coregulation claim; the other genes are only co-correlation reference nodes. Evidence is expression response rather than direct SREBP2 perturbation (observational), and aging/established MASLD are not modeled, so the declared direct context is overclaimed.

evidence_span.text: The qPCR results for Hmgcs1, Hmgcr, Mvd, Idi1, Sqle and Dhcr7 confirmed the genomic analyses, whereas those for Fdft1 did not

reviews.rationale: Glucose-induced coordinated mRNA upregulation confirms Hmgcs1, Idi1, Mvd, and Dhcr7 as cholesterol-biosynthesis genes (Fdft1 not confirmed; Mvk/Pmvk measured but not reported as changed), an associative/expression-only form of the enzymatic-cascade claim. The rat-islet, non-hepatocyte, expression-only evidence is indirect, matching the declared context.
